programme.desc: When a heralded black playwright buys a house on a resort island, cops mistake him for a thief and nearly kill him. But then the Police Chief attempts to cover up the event by planting a small-time criminal in the house to take the rap!

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

programme.title: Left Behind
programme.desc: A small group of survivors is left behind after millions of people suddenly vanish and the world is plunged into chaos and destruction.

programme.title: Shock and Awe
programme.desc: Based on shocking true events in the wake of the 9/11 terror attacks this thought-provoking political thriller stars James Marsden, Woody Harrelson, Jessica Biel and Tommy Lee Jones. Journalists, Jonathan and Warren, are covering George Bush's 2003 invasion of Iraq but become sceptical that Saddam Hussein was hiding "weapons of mass destruction", so challenge the White House. A race against time!

programme.title: Brooklyn's Greatest
programme.desc: A young boxer is taken under the wing of a mob boss after his Mother dies and his Father is run out of town for being an abusive alcoholic.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat espionage thriller, starring Richard Gere and Topher Grace as ex-CIA and FBI agents, trying to find the killer of a US senator, which bears the hallmark of an infamous Soviet assassin, thought to be dead.

programme.title: Swimming with Men
programme.desc: A man who is suffering a mid-life crisis finds new meaning in his life as part of an all-male, middle-aged, amateur synchronised swimming team.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad (1994)
programme.desc: Macaulay Culkin is a clever kid out to reform his small-time crook father (Ted Danson) in this exuberantly zany and heartwarming comedy for the whole family.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: A man discovers that he possesses the ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: A protection agent is tasked with protecting Darius Kincaid, one of the world's most famous assassins.

programme.title: Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Michael Bryce continues his friendship with assassin, Darius Kincaid, as they try to save Darius' wife Sonia.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: A man decides to take justice into his own hands after a plea bargain sets one of his family's killers free.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: When the White House is taken over by terrorists, a former agent must step up and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Roxxy
programme.desc: Bonnie and Clyde meets True Romance in this thrilling and electrifying ride. When Vincent (Emile Hirsch: Lone Survivor) saves Roxxy (Zo Kravitz: X-Men: First Class) from a violent assailant, their lives are suddenly transformed and they find themselves on the run. A jaw-dropping action thriller from the makers of Joker. Highly recommended!

programme.title: Rise of the Krays
programme.desc: The early years of the two of the most notorious British criminals are portrayed in visceral brutality. London, 1961: Ronnie and Reggie Kray begin a reign of terror that would define London's East End for years to come. From protection rackets to members' clubs, street brawls to arson via blackmail extending all the way up to the Cabinet Office, the Krays rained red on anyone who crossed them.

programme.title: Can't Come Out To Play
programme.desc: A disturbing, skin-crawling horror thriller, featuring a stand-out performance from Michael Shannon (The Iceman) and directed by John McNaughton (Wild Things). A mentally unstable physician (Samantha Morton: Minority Report) keeps her dying son secluded from the outside world in a bid to preserve his life. Experience this chilling, psychological horror about a mother's obsessive love. A must see!

programme.title: Romulus v. Remus: The First King
programme.desc: Vikings meets Game of Thrones meets Apocolypto, this historical action epic is the legendary story of two brothers who battled to found the greatest empire history has ever known Rome. With stunning visuals and immersive epic battle scenes, follow Romulus and Remus as they escape captivity, battle sacred fire and violent warriors, leading one of them seal his fate as the chosen one.

programme.title: Surprised by Oxford
programme.desc: Caro, a brilliant but emotionally guarded American student, arrives at the prestigious Oxford University with the sole focus of attaining her PhD.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominees Naomi Watts (King Kong, Mulholland Drive) and Matt Dillon (There's Something About Mary, Crash) star in this thrilling and intense story about a young couple at odds with the American Dream. Melissa Winters (Watts) works as a cashier at the bleak local convenience store...

programme.title: August
programme.desc: ‘Wall Street', ‘Boiler Room' and ‘Shattered Glass' come crashing into the Internet Age in this intense, edge-of-your-seat and emotional tale about one man's fight to keep his dreams alive during the dot-com collapse of 2001.

programme.title: Charming Christmas
programme.desc: (2015) Holiday romance with Julie Benz. An uptight woman agrees to play Mrs Claus at her family's department store, and finds herself becoming merrier working alongside a charming man playing Santa.

programme.title: Christmas By Design
programme.desc: (2023) Festive rom com with Rebecca Dalton. Reluctantly in her hometown for Christmas, can NYC fashion designer Charlotte discover what's really important in life with the help of a charming local?

programme.title: Spotlight on Christmas
programme.desc: A Hollywood actress returns to her hometown during the holidays after a public break-up. Once there, Olivia finally takes a starring role in her own life. Starring Tori Anderson (2020)

programme.title: The Christmas Club
programme.desc: (2019) Yuletide romance starring Elizabeth Mitchell. When two busy strangers unite to help an elderly woman find her Christmas savings, they realise what their lives have been missing: true love.

programme.title: The Christmas Setup
programme.desc: (2020) Festive rom com with Hugo Spencer and Blake Lee. Back home for Christmas, big city lawyer Hugo is set up by his matchmaker mum with his high school crush Patrick. Is the magic still there?

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: From the director of ‘Office Space', and ‘Beavis and Butthead do America', and starring the downright hilarious Jason Bateman, comes a comedy about sexual frustration, litigation, con-artistry, and castration…

programme.title: Tell It to the Bees
programme.desc: When mill worker Lydia is abandoned by her philandering husband, she struggles to look after herself and her son Charlie. Local doctor Jean is one of the few to help and a friendship develops that blossoms into a romance that will scandalise the town.

programme.title: Mark, Mary & Some Other People
programme.desc: Newlyweds, reluctantly decide to give ethical non-monogamy a try as their lives get increasingly complicated.

programme.title: Redeeming Love
programme.desc: Sold into prostitution as a child, Angel knows nothing but betrayal. Can her heart ever be mended? Based upon the novel by Francine Rivers.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding
programme.desc: A month before their wedding, on Christmas Day, Emily is called away for business. When Emily is due to return, a major storm hits making it impossible for her to leave. Emily desperately tries to make it home while Ben gets his act together.

programme.title: Fixing Up Christmas
programme.desc: Known as a “fixer” for difficult clients, a talented party planner must help a young CEO plan the Christmas party of the year to dazzle the mayor and save his company. Wil the "fixer" fix something more than just the company?

programme.title: The Christmas Cure
programme.desc: When Vanessa returns home for Christmas, her name comes up for a huge promotion back at work! She is torn between taking the job or staying home to take over the family clinic, while her visit has rekindled an old romance as well.

programme.title: Nicholas Nickleby (2002)
programme.desc: After Nicholas' father dies and leaves the family penniless, the Nickleby Family moves to London to stay with their Uncle Ralph. Ralph turns abusive and separates the family.

programme.title: Identical Love
programme.desc: After being left at the altar, Dr. Charlotte Hudson needs to escape life at home. She signs up to volunteer at a health clinic in a tropical country. But her plans of escaping are thrown off when she comes across her former fiancé's twin brother, Seth (a dentist), who is also volunteering with the clinic. As they spend time together, Seth falls in love with Charlotte, but she struggles to let go of seeing her fiancé every time she looks at Seth. The island romance will help her break free from the past and love Seth for who he is.

programme.title: Not Cinderella's Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Hope Ranch
programme.desc: A young girl has it all—a beautiful ranch, a horse named Faith, and the love of her family. But after the death of her military father, she and her mother are in danger of losing their family ranch too. With a little help from friends and their majestic white horse, they hatch a plan to raise enough money to save the ranch while learning to never lose hope, despite all odds.

programme.title: Off The Menu
programme.desc: An unlikely heir to a Mexican fast-food franchise goes ‘cuisine' hunting for the next culinary big thing he can ‘borrow,' and finds himself in a small, dusty New Mexican town where people come from all over to salivate over the culinary treats of a local female chef.

programme.title: Honor Student
programme.desc: At his book signing, Reggie meets ex-student Teresa who claims he stole her story.

programme.title: Donna / Danelle / Robert and Ana
programme.desc: A convenience store worker plays dead to escape her abductor.

programme.title: Fatal Reunion
programme.desc: Wife suspects affair, revives old flame, ignites stalker.

programme.title: Dead on Campus
programme.desc: College should have been the best time of Natalie's life.

programme.title: Honor Student
programme.desc: At his book signing, Reggie meets ex-student Teresa who claims he stole her story.

programme.title: The Psycho She Met Online
programme.desc: While her husband heals from a car crash, Karen bonds with their new renter—until another houseguest vanishes.

programme.title: Til Ex Do Us Part
programme.desc: As Kyle and Sophia reconnect, she's accused of assaulting his friend Claire, a woman he slept with once.

programme.title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
programme.desc: At the Gamma Christmas Mixer, Sarah is missing and her friends' search leads to a shocking attack.

programme.title: Dying for the Crown
programme.desc: A new student at a high school stops at nothing to gain popularity and become homecoming queen at the prom.

programme.title: His Secret Past
programme.desc: Popular crime novelist, Jennifer Becker lives a lavish life in a small coastal town in California with her daughter, Lily. One day, while out for a run, Lily is attacked--but then rescued by a mysterious stranger named Mick.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Meryl Streep is Julia Child and Amy Adams is Julie Powell in writer-director Nora Ephron's adaptation of two bestselling memoirs: Powell's Julie & Julia and My Life in France, by Julia Child with Alex Prud'homme. Based on two true stories, Julie & Julia intertwines the lives of two women who, though separated by time and space, are both at loose ends...until they discover that with the right combination of passion, fearlessness and butter, anything is possible.

programme.title: Jack And Jill
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein (Adam Sandler) has his normal tranquil life turned upside down when his twin sister Jill (also Adam Sandler) arrives for visit.

programme.title: Punch-drunk Love
programme.desc: Barry Egan (Adam Sandler), the owner of a struggling vanity plungers company, falls in love with Lena Leonard (Emily Watson), a woman his sister is trying to set him up with. On the run from a gang of thugs, Barry travels to Hawaii, using the frequent flier mile coupons clipped from several cartons of pudding cups, to meet up with this girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Only You (1994)
programme.desc: An incurable romantic goes to Italy in search of an illusive soulmate.

programme.title: Date & Switch
programme.desc: High school seniors Michael and Matty have been best friends since 3rd grade. Still virgins, they make a pact to help each other "score" before Senior Prom. But their mission takes an unexpected turn when Matty announces that he's gay.

programme.title: Plunder Quest
programme.desc: After catching wind of valuable prohibition-era whiskey hidden on an island, Thomas Waters embarks on a quest for liquid gold and ends up on the priceless adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Skye Hoshi
programme.desc: Anime character Skye Hoshi mysteriously becomes real and falls out of her poster, it's up to slacker comic store employee Atom to help her get back home before her anime is destroyed.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Fueled by caffeine and machismo, a rivalry ensues between Nick and Russell. The one-upmanship becomes a contest of wits and wills, where stress is the great equalizer and bravado is the lowest common denominator...

programme.title: Canadian Pacific
programme.desc: A surveyor for the Canadian Pacific Railroad must fight fur trappers who oppose the building of the railroad by stirring up Indian rebellion.

programme.title: Bastard, Go and Kill
programme.desc: Chaco, a Mexican on the run from just about everyone, is framed for the killing of a couple of cattlemen.

programme.title: Shadow of Sartana
programme.desc: Sartana has a bounty on his head and he's wanted dead or alive. To eliminate this he makes a deal with the local politicians. If he hunts down the marauding Randal Brothers, the bounty will be removed.

programme.title: Only the Valiant
programme.desc: Capt. Richard Lance is unjustly held responsible, by his men and girlfriend, for an Indian massacre death of beloved Lt. Holloway. Holloway is killed while escorting a dangerous Indian chief to another fort's prison. The chief escapes. Knowing their fort is in danger of Indian attack, Lance takes a small group of army misfits to an abandoned nearby army fort to defend a mountain pass against the oncoming Indian assault. Their mission is to stall for time until reinforcements from another fort arrive. The men in this small group of malcontents, deserters, psychopaths and cowards all hate Capt. Lance and wish him dead. Much to their chagrin, the men recognize that Lance's survival instincts, military knowledge and leadership are the only chance the group has of staying alive.

programme.title: They Call Him Cemetery
programme.desc: John and George McIntire are a couple of naive brothers who travel to a lawless western town to see their father.

programme.title: The Arsenal Stadium Mystery
programme.desc: A footballer collapses during a match and Scotland Yard investigates when poison is discovered.

programme.title: Young Wives' Tale
programme.desc: London, post WW2: The housing shortage causes two very different types of families to cohabitate.

programme.title: Hunted
programme.desc: When six-year-old Robbie runs away he stumbles upon a man, Chris, with a dead body.

programme.title: Checkpoint
programme.desc: A watchman is shot in a factory and a mysterious saboteur escapes into the shadows.

programme.title: Double Exposure
programme.desc: Pete Fleming is a private detective called into service by an advertising executive

programme.title: Etched in Stone
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Stewie Harper head to Stockholm, Sweden to find the Runestone of King Jann I of Norway.

programme.title: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Dublin, Ireland in search of the missing crown of the last King of Ireland.

programme.title: A Vanishing Art
programme.desc: Accompanying Max the magician, Sydney and Nigel journey to Atlantic City, New Jersey in search of Hungary's lost and allegedly cursed Royal Scepter.

programme.title: Love Letter
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to France to look for the lost wedding vows of Josephine Pontoise and Guy de Bourdin, which would prove their heir is the rightful owner of St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: A Good Year
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to France to find the lost stones from Marie Antoinette's Crown.

programme.title: Nothing But the Truth
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are reunited with Stewie Harper in the search for the Chalice of Truth in France.

programme.title: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Paris, France after the Sword of Jacques de Molay, Grand Master of the Knights Templar. Rival relic hunter Rita Rosellini is also after the sword.

programme.title: Possessed
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are in Brussels, Belgium in search of the sacred sundial of Zeus in order to stop the Vampires.

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: A New Yorker, takes up a job as a security with the Empire State Armoured Truck Company after failing to secure a job with the NYPD. After discovering that he is able to use his position to his advantage, he is drawn into an elaborate scheme to rob his company, resulting in the largest cash heist.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: The men of Bravo Company are facing a battle that's all uphill… up Hamburger Hill. Fourteen war-weary soldiers are battling for a mud-covered mound of earth so named because it chews up soldiers like chopped meat. They are fighting for their country, their fellow soldiers and their lives.

programme.title: Crossfire
programme.desc: Jonas ‘Malo' Moldanado (Curtis ‘50 Cent' Jackson) is a fresh faced recruit in the NYPD, taken under the wing of a corrupt police chief Sarcone (Robert DeNiro) Malo get dragged deeper and deeper into a world of drugs, violence and crime.

programme.title: The Son of No One
programme.desc: A young cop (Channing Tatum) is assigned to a precinct in the working class neighborhood where he grew up, where an old secret threatens to destroy his family.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: An ex-con sets out to avenge his brother's death after they were double-crossed during a heist years ago. During his campaign, however, he's tracked by a veteran cop and an egocentric hit man.

programme.title: The Evil Dead (1983)
programme.desc: Five twentysomething friends are holed up in a remote cabin where they discover a Book Of The Dead. An archaeologist's tape recording reveals that the ancient text was discovered among the Khandarian ruins of a Sumerian civilization. Playing the taped incantations, the youths unwittingly summon up dormant demons living in the nearby woods, which possess the youngsters in succession until only one is left intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinction
programme.desc: Milla Jovovich is back to kill more zombies in the third chapter of the hit Resident Evil franchise! An action/horror film filled with huge special effects and edge-of-your-seat terror! Survivors of the Raccoon City catastrophe travel across the Nevada desert, hoping to make it to Alaska. Alice (Jovovich) joins the caravan and their fight against the evil Umbrella Corp.

programme.title: The Art Of War
programme.desc: Shaw is an operative for the United Nations' covert dirty-tricks squad, using espionage and quasi-ethical tactics to secure peace and cooperation. When a shipping container full of dead Vietnamese refugees turns up on the docks and China's ambassador is gunned down at a dinner celebrating a new trade agreement with China and the US, Shaw is framed for the murder and must evade the FBI and Triad gangsters to find out what is really going on.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ryan Porter & Kamasi Washington
programme.sub-title: Ryan Porter & The West Coast Get Down - BIRD
programme.desc: Los Angeles-born saxophonist Kamasi Washington and trombonist Ryan Porter co-founded West Coast Get Down – a musical collective fusing jazz and funk with hip-hop. It is partly because of this collective that jazz saw a resurgence in Los Angeles, subtly eclipsing the long-established jazz mecca of the world, New York City. The two musicians join forces and take the vibes of Los Angeles to jazz club BIRD in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Yumi Ito
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick
programme.sub-title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in 's-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Evgeny Kissin, Iddo Bar-Shai & Arielle Beck
programme.sub-title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration - I
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame' of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Iddo Bar-Shaï, and Arielle Beck violinists Gidon Kremer, Maxim Vengerov, and Tedi Papavrami cellist Mischa Maisky, Flugelhorn player Sergei Nakariakov, as well as her daughter and grandson: Lyda Chen-Argerich (piano and viola) and David Chen-Argerich (piano). On the program are Alfred Schnittke's Congratulatory rondo for piano and violin Preludes No. 5, 21, and 24 from Mieczysław Weinberg's 24 Preludes, Op. 100 (arranged for solo violin by G. Kremer) ‘Waltz' and ‘Slava' from Sergei Rachmaninoff's 6 Morceaux, Op. 11, and Romance for six hands Fritz Kreisler's Liebesleid Robert Schumann's Fantasiestücke Op. 73, and Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44 and ‘Laideronnette, impératrice des Pagodes' from Maurice Ravel's Ma mère l'Oye. This performance was recorded on June 11, 2021.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic & David Cohen
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections') is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Blondie
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Blondie performs her hits including ''Heart of Glass", "Euphoria", ''Mile High" and many more…

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Blue Horizons
programme.desc: Blue Horizons features a diverse set of strikingly blue nature video scenes from places like Hawaii, Mexico, Canada, and California. It is paired with a custom written ambient track by Travis Revell / Relax Moods. ABOUT THE COLOR BLUE: The color blue has a cooling, and soothing effect upon the nervous system, and upon the bloody and bodily organs. "Turquoise is cerebrally calming, and is an effective color for sound sleep. Blue stimulates intuitive powers and is a vitality builder, and is also said to help activate the pineal gland as it is the color of the spirit." -From the book Color Medicine by C. Klotsche*

programme.title: A Day on the Napali Coast 4

Viewers will enjoy a countless array of views that overlook the vast blue ocean, where an abundance of wildlife and nature appear in their pristine and healing majesty.

programme.desc: Cuando un reportero ganador de un Premio Pulitzer es asesinado en un hotel en Barcelona, su hermano Dan Kovacks comienza su propia investigación, descubriendo pruebas de que su hermano estaba a punto de hacer pública la existencia de un complot internacional bajo el nombre de "Mega-Bill". Una falsificación casi perfecta del billete de 100 dólares estadounidense. Pero los orígenes de la conspiración van más allá de la falsificación de divisas y podría provocar una guerra nuclear entre varios países de gran poder. ¿Quién trabaja para quién? ¿En quién puede confiar Dan?

programme.title: En casa con Tori
programme.desc: Tori le organiza a su hijo de cinco años una épica fiesta de cumpleaños de Spiderman.

programme.title: No Volverás a Verla

programme.title: Recuerdos de Navidad

programme.title: Las diabólicas
programme.desc: El director de un colegio, el señor Delasalle, convive con su esposa y su amante, la profesora Horner. Pero las dos mujeres, cansadas de sufrir la constante tiranía y malos tratos del hombre que comparten, deciden que esa situación no puede continuar...

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: En 1910, Elinor Randall, viuda, y su joven hija llegan a una árida región de Wyoming después de que Clyde Stewart, un ranchero...

programme.title: La mujer zurda
programme.desc: Después de pasar unos días sin verse, Marianne se encuentra con Bruno, su marido, y le comunica que deberían separarse. La mujer y su hijo se trasladan a Francia y se instalan en una gran casa medio vacía rodeada de trenes. Allí realiza traducciones para sobrevivir, mientras su calidad de exiliada alemana en un París contemporáneo y hostil la encamina lentamente hacia la locura.

programme.title: Chantaje contra una esposa
programme.desc: Nora Helmer, casada y con cuatro hijos pequeños, parece una mujer feliz. Aunque su marido es muy autoritario y dominante, el carácter alegre y algo frívolo de Nora hace soportable la situación. Pero, años atrás, Nora, sin conocimiento de su marido, contrajo una deuda que intenta liquidar sustrayendo pequeñas sumas al presupuesto familiar.

programme.title: El tiempo del lobo
programme.desc: Anna y su familia llegan a su casa de campo para lo que parece un tranquilo fin de semana. La casa ha sido ocupada por otra familia que les exige con violencia inusitada el agua y los alimentos. Tras el enfrentamiento, los asaltantes obligan a Anna y a sus hijos a huir. Estos se dirigen al pueblo más cercano en busca de refugio y alimentos. Pero, tras la hecatombe a la que se refieren algunas emisoras de radio, la comida y el agua se han convertido en un bien escaso que nadie está dispuesto a compartir.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: Los viajeros de la noche
programme.desc: Un joven cowboy, seducido por una chica nueva en la ciudad, descubre que ha sido mordido por un vampiro. Lentamente se convierte en una criatura de la noche alimentándose con la sangre de sus víctimas.

programme.title: Monsternado
programme.desc: Un tornado, infestado de monstruos prehistóricos, se ha formado en el Triángulo de las Bermudas y se dirige hacia tierra firme. Ahora la ciudad debe luchar para sobrevivir contra estas criaturas mortales.

programme.title: El tercer asesinato
programme.desc: El conocido abogado Shigemori defiende a Misumi, acusado de robo con homicidio, que ya cumplió pena de cárcel por otro asesinato hace treinta años.

programme.title: El medallón perdido: Las aventuras de Billy Stone
programme.desc: Billy encuentra un medallón que lo llevará en el tiempo junto a su amiga Allie.

programme.title: George y el dragón
programme.desc: Jorge, un apuesto caballero, acaba de regresar de las Cruzadas con la intención de vivir en paz.

programme.title: Parejas Criminales
programme.desc: La Policía de Singapur confía en Lim Chin Chin, Directora de Forense.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon presencia un asesinato y huye de policías corruptos. Jack, un exagente, la ayuda a sobrevivir.

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas
programme.desc: Un viudo se ve atrapado en un enfrentamiento mortal entre policías y una peligrosa banda criminal.

programme.title: Skybound
programme.desc: Cinco amigos a bordo de un pequeño avión rumbo a Los Ángeles pierden misteriosamente la conexión por radio. Cuando descubren a Erik, un polizón que les insta a no aterrizar, asumen que un gran desastre ha tenido lugar en la superficie.

programme.title: Dead Man Down (La venganza del hombre muerto)
programme.desc: Espectacular historia de venganza en forma de frenético thriller sobre dos personas obsesionadas y heridas por el pasado, la mano derecha de un mafioso (Colin Farrell) y una misteriosa mujer víctima de un crimen, que juntos llevarán a cabo un oscuro y violento plan de venganza.

programme.title: Dark Was the Night
programme.desc: En el remoto pueblo de Maiden Woods comienzan a sucederse una serie de sanguinarios crímenes. Unas extrañas huellas parecen señalar a algún tipo de animal como principal sospechoso. Mientras la población vive atemorizada por los acontecimientos, el Sheriff Paul Shield investiga el caso.

programme.title: El mensajero
programme.desc: Brillante thriller entretenido y con mensaje sobre un padre (Dwayne Johnson) que, desesperado después de que su hijo sea acusado por error en un caso de tráfico de drogas, se ve obligado por la DEA a infiltrarse en un peligroso cártel donde deberá arriesgar su propia vida para salvar la de su hijo.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: 'Big Eyes' está basada en la historia real de Walter Keane, uno de los pintores más exitosos de los años 50. El artista alcanzó una notoriedad asombrosa con sus enigmáticas pinturas de niños abandonados con grandes ojos. La autora era Margaret, su mujer, pero en realidad los firmaba Walter.

programme.title: Un perro divino
programme.desc: Jake, un patriarca de familia, sufre un terrible accidente de coche en el que pierde a su esposa e hijos y tan sólo su perro Cooper y él consiguen salir con vida. Jake no es un amante de los animales y además está resentido con su perro ya que es el único superviviente de su mayor desgracia.

programme.title: El profesor de Persa
programme.desc: Francia, 1942. Gilles es arrestado por soldados de las SS junto con otros judíos y enviado a un campo de concentración en Alemania. allí consigue evitar la ejecución al jurar a los guardias que no es judío, sino persa.

programme.title: Un pequeño mundo
programme.desc: Nora entra en primaria cuando descubre el acoso que sufre su hermano mayor, Abel. Nora se debate entre su padre, que la anima a actuar, la necesidad de integrarse y su hermano, que le pide que guarde silencio: un terrible conflicto de lealtad.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: Historia romántica teñida de crimen que te mantiene al borde del asiento. Baron (Joe Keery), recientemente encarcelado, entabla amistad con su compañero de celda Otis (Aldis Hodge), un hombre con un amplio historial de fugas de prisión.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: Septiembre la vida de Antonio se tambalea con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amiga a la que no ve 6 años.

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Reencuentro con un primer amor: el reto de no caer dos veces.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: El Príncipe Carlos llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Perdido en Florencia
programme.desc: Eric Lombard es un americano con el corazón roto en una fase de su vida en la que tras tomar varias decisiones, decide viajar a Florencia. Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: La retorcidas mentes de dos de los seis guionistas de Scary Movie dan una vuelta de tuerca al género de la comedia romántica en DATE MOVIE.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: Un manitas con problemas matrimoniales se encuentra con un ama de casa con los mismos.

programme.title: La vecina de al lado
programme.desc: Matthew, es un joven ambicioso que sueña con llegar a ser político algún día. De pronto, se enamora perdidamente de Danielle, su vecina de la puerta de al lado. Ambos comienzan un romance, pero un sorprendente descubrimiento pondrá a prueba su relación: ella fue actriz porno.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Dublín, 1904, James Joyce conversa con Nora Barnacle, una empleada de hotel recién llegada de Galway. Ella lo encanta con su manera franca y desinhibida y, en poco tiempo, él la convence para que lo acompañe a Trieste.

programme.title: Sin dejar huellas
programme.desc: Un policía con problemas de alcoholismo investiga la desaparición de un adolescente de la misma edad que su hijo, con el que mantiene una relación problemática.

programme.title: Regreso a Hope Gap
programme.desc: Un joven viaja a un pueblo costero cerca de Hope Gap para pasar un fin de semana junto a sus padres. Una vez allí, su padre le confiesa su intención de marcharse de casa cuanto antes y poner fin a sus 29 años de matrimonio. Después de esta noticia, cada miembro de la familia tendrá que buscar la manera de recomponerse y tratar de salir adelante.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Una sociedad rígidamente clasista es el obstáculo que se opone a la relación entre Miss Julie, la hija de un conde, y Jean, un sirviente.

programme.title: Los amantes
programme.desc: Lisa y Simon son inseparables. Han estado locamente enamorados el uno del otro desde que eran adolescentes.

programme.title: La clase dirigente
programme.desc: Cuando un miembro de la Cámara de los Lores deja su patrimonio a su hijo Jack, un joven desequilibrado que se cree Jesucristo, los otros miembros de la familia intentarán arrebatarle la herencia.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama.

programme.title: La Coartada
programme.desc: Ray Elliott tiene un trabajo muy especial: se dedica a encubrir las relaciones matrimoniales de sus clientes.

programme.title: Un lío inesperado
programme.desc: Un matrimonio viaja por separado (con sus amantes)… ¡al mismo sitio!

programme.title: Sex Monster
programme.desc: En Los Ángeles, el contratista Marty Barnes está emocionado por haber convencido a su reluctante esposa para participar en un menage-a-trois con otra mujer.

programme.title: American Hero
programme.desc: Melvin, un superhéroe a regañadientes, vive solo para el crimen, las mujeres y las drogas, hasta que se da cuenta de que la única forma de volver a ver a su hijo, del que está distanciado, es enderezarse y desarrollar su potencial como luchador contra el crimen.

programme.title: Amor idiota
programme.desc: Pere Lluc se entera de que un amigo suyo ha muerto hace cinco meses. Para olvidar sus penas, se va de fiesta y se emborracha, chocándose con una mujer que está trabajando.

programme.title: Los babymakers
programme.desc: Divertida comedia cargada de chistes sexuales sobre un hombre que, tras varios intentos de dejar embarazada a su mujer sin éxito, pide a sus amigos que roben el depósito de esperma que años atrás dejó en un banco de donaciones. Empieza una divertida misión con un solo objetivo: tener un hijo.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Contratado para robar el fabuloso diamante Queen, el enano ladrón Calvin Sims (Marlon Wayans) y su tonto compañero Percy (Tracy Morgan) guardan la piedra en la bolsa de mano de Vanessa Edwards (Kerry Washington, Ray) cuando su plan de escape sale mal. Al descubrir al esposo de Vanessa, Darryl (Shawn Wayans), que está desesperado por ser padre, Calvin intercambia sus jugarretas por pañales y se hace pasar por un bebé abandonado. Sufriendo un número de graciosas humillaciones y salidas familiares, Calvin desesperadamente trata de recuperar la gema antes de que lo descubran, y Darryl y Vanessa no están ayudando en nada. Dirigida por Keenen Ivory Wayans (White Chicks).

programme.title: El Hombre De La Casa
programme.desc: Cuando cinco alegres animadoras son testigo del asesinato de un confidente, requieren vigilancia las veinticuatro horas del día para evitar ser las siguientes víctimas. En eso que entra el duro Ranger de Texas, el teniente Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones), que se hace pasar por su segundo entrenador alojándose en el campus universitario. Pero estas enérgicas jovencitas solo quieren salir fiesta y el estirado Sharp aprende que no es un trabajo fácil mantener fuera de peligro a estas incontrolables estudiantes. Cedric the Entertainer se une a este fogoso reparto en una comedia llena de energía, orgullo y la alegría de un Ranger de Texas que se pone en contacto con su lado femenino.

programme.title: Juerga Hasta El Fin
programme.desc: Durante una fiesta celebrada en Los Angeles con motivo de la inauguración de la nueva casa de James Franco, los también actores Seth Rogen, Jay Baruchel y otras celebridades se enfrentan al Apocalipsis del fin del mundo pronosticado por los mayas.

programme.title: Rough Night
programme.desc: En Rough Night, una noche de mucha fiesta toma un giro divertidamente oscuro cuando cinco mejores amigas matan accidentalmente a un estríper masculino.

programme.title: El día de los forajidos
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett es un ranchero que se enfrenta a los granjeros cuando los forajidos asaltan el pequeño pueblo. Los forajidos sólo son controlados por su notorio líder, pero se le diagnostica una herida mortal y el pueblo es un polvorín a punto de estallar.

programme.title: El ángel vengador
programme.desc: Un predicador se convierte en cazarrecompensas después de que un grupo de refugiados que busca cobijo en su iglesia sea asesinado por una banda de despiadados forajidos.

programme.title: El poni rojo
programme.desc: Un niño de rancho es dotado con un potro, crece para amarlo pero el potro se escapa, con resultados trágicos.

programme.title: Relevo para un pistolero
programme.desc: Un desconocido de Boston ofrece a un notorio ex forajido de Arizona un trabajo que no puede rechazar.

programme.title: Eminence Hill
programme.desc: Un rastro de venganza lleva a un famoso asesino y un abogado a una ciudad de fanáticos, en donde la sangre fluirá.

programme.title: Industria Argentina
programme.desc: La crisis económica provocó la quiebra de muchas empresas. En una fábrica metalúrgica, los trabajadores se resisten a perder su única forma de sobrevivir. John es uno de esos empleados que durante meses no ha cobrado.

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: ¿Qué ocurre cuando estalla una epidemia y no se sabe nada de ella? Puede ocurrir cualquier cosa. Poco a poco, los residentes se dan cuenta de que todos morirán a menos que se unan.

programme.title: Entre dos mundos
programme.desc: Pasó del peor gueto de Nueva York a las mejores escuelas del país. Estaba viviendo el sueño americano. Entonces, ¿qué salió mal?

programme.title: La gran pelea
programme.desc: Helena, marcada por la rivalidad con su hermana por el amor de su madre, se adentra en el boxeo y gana fama como “La Ruda”. Admirada y temida, atrae la atención de “La Diabla”, líder del microtráfico. Entre deudas, tensiones y la frágil salud de su madre, Helena y su hermana deberán enfrentarse en la pelea decisiva de sus vidas.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Exorcismo en Georgia
programme.desc: Poco después de trasladarse a su nueva casa en Georgia una pareja se entera de que su hija tiene misteriosas visiones de personas que nadie más que ella parece ver. Finalmente ellos también son testigos de extraños fenómenos que tienen lugar alrededor de la casa y que van aportando pistas de lo que podría ser un escalofriante misterio que se ha mantenido en secreto durante generaciones.

programme.title: Movie 43
programme.desc: Comedia hilarante formada por una serie de historias, dirigidas entre otros por los hermanos Farrelly y con un reparto coral espectacular e insólito hasta la fecha: Naomi Watts, Kate Winslet, Hugh Jackman, Uma Thurman, Emma Stone, Richard Gere, Gerard Butler y Halle Berry entre otros.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: Cuando los amos duermen
programme.desc: Samuel y Lourdes son un humilde matrimonio que se desvive cuidando los terrenos y la casa de su Señor. El dueño de la casa es Víctor, un vampiro ancestral que solo se alimenta de la sangre de gente malvada.

programme.title: Viejos
programme.desc: Manuel tiene que mudarse a la casa de su hijo Mario y la familia de éste después de que un terrible suceso acabe con la vida de su anciana mujer. Poco a poco, la realidad se impone: algo incomprensible ocurre con Manuel.

programme.title: Pieles
programme.desc: En un extraño mundo en que la humanidad es deforme, todos buscan a quien les acepte tal como son. Sigue la historia de personas físicamente diferentes que, por este motivo, se han visto obligadas a esconderse, recluirse o unirse entre ellas.

programme.title: ärtico
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes “quinquis” salen cada día despreocupadamente a la calle para buscarse la vida con lo que les salga. Pero además de sus cotidianos robos y trapicheos, algo les revuelve en su interior.

programme.title: Tombstone Rashomon
programme.desc: The Tombstone story told in the style of the Japanese classic "Rashomon", where we see history from several perspectives including that of Wyatt Earp, Doc Holliday, Kate, Ike Clanton, Colonel Hafford and Johnny Behan.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality: The Monster Within and Among Us
programme.desc: Episode One discusses 'The Monster Within And Among Us', and discusses Jack The Ripper (even though he's not American), since he is pretty much the first recognized serial killer. Since a lack of real footage is obvious, this episode uses footage from an old black and white move, loosely based on Jack The Ripper.

programme.title: End of the World
programme.desc: After witnessing a man's death in a bizarre accident, Father Pergado goes on a spiritual retreat, where he encounters his alien double bent on world conquest.

programme.title: Deadly Crush
programme.desc: When a painter rents a secluded cabin to jump start her creativity, she has sex with a ghost and finds herself part of his plan to bring itself back to life.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: Killdozer
programme.desc: A small construction crew on an island is terrorized when a spirit-like being takes over a large bulldozer, and goes on a killing rampage.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality: The Monster Within and Among Us
programme.desc: Episode One discusses 'The Monster Within And Among Us', and discusses Jack The Ripper (even though he's not American), since he is pretty much the first recognized serial killer. Since a lack of real footage is obvious, this episode uses footage from an old black and white move, loosely based on Jack The Ripper.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: El agresor
programme.desc: David Sloan debe viajar a México para salvar a su mujer de un salvaje narcotraficante, que además es un viejo némesis.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: Truth or Die
programme.desc: Un millonario ha sido brutalmente asesinado en su casa y se han llevado un valioso maletín de la caja de seguridad. Cuando el guardaespaldas del millonario regresa a la escena del crimen, se encuentra con tres testigos-sospechosos: el hijo del millonario, una joven aparentemente dulce y un mago bohemio. Los tres relatan las escenas del asesinato desde puntos de vista opuestos, cada uno con una versión diferente de quién cometió el crimen.

programme.title: The Tracker
programme.desc: Un misterioso forastero visita un remoto pueblo donde su mujer y su hija fueron secuestradas quince años antes.

programme.title: El Primer Circulo
programme.desc: El clan Malakian, una familia de gángsters despiadados, controla los bajos fondos del sur de Francia.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: Amenaza terrorista
programme.desc: Ewan es un agente del Servicio Secreto cuya misión consiste en capturar y eliminar a Ash, un terrorista suicida, y a la célula a la que pertenece. Mientras tanto, Ash se enfrenta a un dilema moral.

programme.title: Una noche de venganza
programme.desc: Thriller de venganza y secuestros cargado de acción con Morgan Freeman interpretando a un expolicía corrupto que recluta a Victoria (Ruby Rose) para que recolecte millones en dinero blanqueado. Pero ella pronto descubre los siniestros planes de Damon.

programme.title: Asalto a Wall Street
programme.desc: Un neoyorquino medio que lo pierde todo con la crisis financiera del 2008, culpa de su desgracia a los banqueros de Wall Street, que se convierten en el objetivo de su venganza

programme.title: En nombre del rey
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado Farmer se propone rescatar a su esposa secuestrada y vengar la muerte de su hijo.

programme.title: Terra Nova
programme.desc: Con la abolición de la pena de muerte, las cárceles están desbordadas en todo el mundo.

programme.title: El Chicano

programme.title: Tierra Marciana

Al unir fuerzas con otro grupo de supervivientes, se entera de que se ha liberado un virus mortal. ¿Existe aún esperanza para la humanidad, o el mortífero virus de la «rabia» ha infectado a todo el planeta?
